title: EXPLAIN & EXPLAIN ANALYZE
description: Read PostgreSQL query execution plans, interpret Sequential Scan, Index Scan, Bitmap Heap Scan, and detect plan cost estimation errors.

data.text: **`EXPLAIN`** shows the query plan generated by the PostgreSQL cost-based optimizer without executing the query. **`EXPLAIN ANALYZE`** actually runs the query, displaying both estimated costs and real-world execution metrics (actual execution time, buffer cache hits, and rows returned).

data.title: Comprehensive EXPLAIN ANALYZE Command
data.content: Captures buffer cache hits and actual timing.
data.code:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, VERBOSE, SETTINGS)
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) 
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY c.name;

rows: Scans entire table heap sequentially from first to last page.
Small tables (<1000 rows) or queries returning >20% of the table.
Traverses B-tree to leaf, then fetches each row individually from heap.
Queries retrieving a small percentage of rows by an indexed filter.
Reads all required data directly from index leaf pages (zero heap reads).
Optimal for high-throughput queries with covering indexes.
Gathers matched row pointers into an in-memory bitmap, then reads heap pages sequentially.
Filtering by multiple conditions with `OR` or range queries.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `EXPLAIN` estimates cost; `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` measures actual execution runtime.
Compare `rows=...` (estimated) with `actual rows=...` to detect stale statistics.
`BUFFERS` shows shared buffer cache hits vs physical disk reads.
